title: Youth and Adult Literacy — International Literacy Day 2025 factsheet
author: UNESCO Institute for Statistics
alt_text: UN factsheet: global adult literacy crept from 86% to 88% (2015–2024), ~739–754 million adults still cannot read (63% women), and in sub-Saharan Africa the absolute number of illiterate adults ROSE from ~196M toward ~225M.
notes: See also UN SDG Report Goal 4: https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/report/2025/goal-04/ and World Bank/UNESCO post-COVID 'learning poverty' estimates (~70%).
